title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold
tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today, I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: White captions sit over her pale shirt without a sufficiently strong dark outline or background, reducing contrast and readability.
The longest caption reaches into the right-side TikTok interface area; fitting inside the video frame alone does not make it interface-safe.
The greeting changes the required punctuation to “Hi, everyone.”
The phrase “three easy ways” is split between caption cards, creating an awkward reading break.

judge.summary: The output is a face-preserving vertical clip with large captions, but weak contrast and insufficient right-side clearance need fixing before posting.

must_haves.item: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
must_haves.why: The displayed frames are 9:16, and the reported output duration is 10.1 seconds with the complete spoken sentence retained.

must_haves.item: The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
must_haves.why: The captions are large and bold, but white lettering over a pale shirt lacks strong contrast; no first-version caption sample is available for comparison.

must_haves.item: The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
must_haves.why: All spoken words appear across the sampled captions, but the transcript has no word-level timestamps, so precise synchronization cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
must_haves.why: The lines fit within the frame and have bottom clearance, but the longer lines extend too far right for TikTok controls.

must_haves.item: The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
must_haves.why: Her entire face remains visible and natural in every supplied output frame, with captions positioned below it.

must_haves.item: The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript confirms English speech but cannot establish voice identity or rule out added music.
